issues.description: Robotic Controls naming not fully standardized to abbreviated form
issues.suggestion: MAJ-004 resolution specified canonical names as 'RC II (Base)', 'RC III', etc., but factory-formulas.md still uses long form 'Robotic Controls II', 'Robotic Controls III'. Consider updating to abbreviated form for full consistency, though current naming is internally consistent within the document.

summary: Task fix-002 (Resolve Consistency Issues) passes verification. The critical requirement of BASE_GROWTH_RATE = 0.10 is correctly set in race-stats-complete.md (Constants section). Robotic Controls tech levels in factory-formulas.md are correct (tech levels 10, 16, 23, 30, 38 for RC III through RC VII). The naming uses long form 'Robotic Controls II/III/IV' consistently within the document rather than the abbreviated 'RC II/III/IV' mentioned in the resolution report, which is a minor stylistic inconsistency but does not affect functionality. The consistency-resolved.md report is comprehensive and documents all resolutions properly.
